killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
why: Restores what the versus pane shipped before issue #274: `justify-content: center` on an `overflow-y: auto` column puts the overflow ABOVE the scrollable area, where no scrollbar reaches it. Latent while the map row was a line of pills; a defect the moment the row became seven cards, measured at 1280x800 with the Mode and Players rows pushed off the top and unreachable. jsdom lays nothing out, so the case that kills this reads the computed `justify-content` of every scroller the fixture builds and asserts that set is EMPTY -- issue #642 has since top-aligned the last two siblings that carried the shape, so there is no residual left to pin. The scroller names are pinned in the same assertion, which is what stops an empty result meaning the sweep measured nothing.
